whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bauji Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.4★ reviews near Dashratha More on Bypass Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food menu inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, full food menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bauji

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Bauji Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Bauji Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, and your Sipara Bypass location highlight. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, photos aur contact setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
